beans.name: Buena Vista Dark Roast
beans.description: Characterized by its deep structure and full body, Buena Vista's Latin American roots yield a dark chocolate savor with a caramelized sweetness. Selected for their balance and dense flavor characteristics, these Southern Colombian coffees stand up to a deeper roast, lending a smooth and adaptable flavor profile. If you like waking up to a dark, rich flavor, look no further.

recipes.title: Verve Buena Vista Dark Roast Dwell
recipes.description: Verve's Dwell Dripper suggestion for Buena Vista: 20 g to 300 g at 1:15 on a medium grind, drawn down at 2:15.

recipes.title: Verve Buena Vista Dark Roast French Press
recipes.description: Verve's French press suggestion for Buena Vista: 35 g to 525 g at 1:15 on a medium grind, four and a half minutes.
